facts.fact: Daily Nation reports that Data Commissioner Immaculate Kassait, in a determination dated 15 February 2025, ordered Wananchi Group (Zuku) to pay a former customer Sh500,000 for ignoring requests to stop promotional messages and erase his data.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)

facts.fact: Daily Nation reports that Data Commissioner Immaculate Kassait headed the ODPC when it took up the complaint, searched Zuku's premises under a warrant and issued the determination of 15 February 2025.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)
